There is a modest clinic located at the end of a modest shopping street. However, the clinic has a secret,  any woman can relax not only her body, but also the depths of her soul.

Today, beautiful women visit the clinic for the irresistibly comfortable "dismantling. The practitioner uses hypnosis! The beautiful women become puppets after tasting the deep pleasures of hypnosis.
